title: Where the water column favours salt fingers
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature and salinity for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine where and at which depths the vertical gradients of temperature and salinity favour double-diffusive mixing, by salt fingers or by diffusive convection, how strongly, how this changes with season, latitude and year, and which water masses set the pattern. Estimate how much double diffusion could add to vertical mixing there, and state what monthly means on the product's vertical levels can and cannot show about a process that acts on scales of metres.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
